summary: The StaffMessageService is a web service designed to retrieve staff messages based on a given StaffMessage ID. It is part of the HSPnet.WebServices namespace and conforms to the WsiProfiles.BasicProfile1_1 standard.
purpose: The purpose of the StaffMessageService is to provide a means to retrieve the text of a specific staff message using an ID and session hash, facilitating access to message content in a secure and controlled manner.

fields.name: sessionHash
fields.description: A session hash used to retrieve the session ID.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the staff message.

workflows.name: Retrieve Staff Message
steps: Use the session hash to get the session ID.
Search for the staff message using the session ID and message ID.
If the message is found, return the message text.
If no message is found, return an empty string.

conditions: If the message is found, return the message text.
If no message is found, return an empty string.
system_behavior: Retrieves a staff message text based on provided session hash and message ID.
